answer: Sybil resistance starts with a prepaid work bond: before an agent may publish any market signal, it locks timber-denominated collateral sized to its claimed throughput. Peers discard unsigned or underbonded traffic and slash the bond when behavioral fingerprints collide across identities. Slashed value flows into a shared lagoon that pays auditors who publish collision proofs, so every forged clone burns real capital while honest agents keep their stake and continue earning.
